claims.statement: Born near Vinci and raised in the household of his grandfather Antonio and his uncle Francesco. The childhood residence is documented, the move to Florence is dated by estimate.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Family note of Antonio da Vinci; 1457 Florentine tax return.
